product_overview: StudiFy is an AI-powered, gamified study platform that helps learners stay motivated by combining an interactive AI study assistant, progress analytics, and an in-app coin economy for rewards and customization.
core_goals: Get AI-guided help for study questions and topics to improve understanding.
Track study progress, streaks, and analytics to monitor learning over time.
Earn and spend in-app coins to unlock customizations and rewards.
Quickly authenticate and access a personalized dashboard to continue studying.

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Allow users to create an account and sign in with an email and password so they can access personalized study features.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Submit signup form -> See dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Submit login form -> See dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Submit login form -> See error message on invalid credentials

features.name: User Dashboard (Profile)
features.description: Provide a personalized dashboard showing study insights, active streaks, coin balance, and recent activity so users can monitor progress at a glance.
user_flows: Navigate to /profile -> See study progress charts -> View coins balance -> See recent quizzes and active streak
Navigate to /profile -> Inspect a specific chart or metric -> Observe trend or statistic update

features.name: AI Study Assistant
features.description: Offer an interactive chatbot tutor where users ask study questions and receive guided, explanatory responses to deepen understanding.
user_flows: Navigate to /study-assistant -> Type question in chat box -> Send message -> See AI response
Navigate to /study-assistant -> Type follow-up question -> Send message -> See AI follow-up response

features.name: Coin Shop
features.description: Let users browse and spend earned coins on virtual items or customizations and see their coin balance update after purchases.
user_flows: Navigate to /setup-shop -> Browse shop items -> Select item to buy -> Confirm purchase -> See updated balance
Navigate to /setup-shop -> Browse shop items -> Select item with cost greater than current balance -> Attempt to confirm purchase -> See insufficient balance error message
